scope: Independently authored process-identity observer for the repository's effect-free MCP relay
constraints: Standard library only; no previous implementation or upstream fixture input
Only records its own PID and current process group before exec of the adjacent owned-relay binary
At most 32 records and 1024 file bytes, mode 0600, no symlink following, nonblocking exclusive lock
Forwards existing descriptors and arguments without parsing or recording MCP frames, prompts, credentials or tool output
Accepts only the relay --config entry or the independent --version identity control
Does not change process groups or assert effective execution restrictions
